The upper frame is inscribed with the seal "Collected by the Zhang family in Changzhou" in vermilion.　　This painting is a portrait of a person with a background. The main character, Yong Rong, is sitting in front of the pond in full spirit, and in front of him is a blue water lotus pond that "goes by the waves with the shade and comes with the wind with the shadow", and behind him is a dense bamboo forest that is thriving. The bamboo and the lotus reflect each other, which stains the beautiful scenery of the June day and implies the "gentlemanly" quality of the person being painted.　　The bamboo forest occupies the upper half of the painting, the bamboo trunk is rounded and neatly painted, the flexible lines accurately portray the flexibility and beauty of the bamboo, the bamboo leaves are directly stained with juicy green, the leaves overlap and stagger, and the coloring is heavy in the front and light in the back, which not only enriches the hierarchical changes of the color scale, but also expands the sense of space from near to far.　　The figure is depicted in the traditional Chinese portrait painting method, with the face first modeled in light ochre lines to draw the skeletal outline, then painted in ochre to express the skin tone, and finally in heavy ink to draw the eyebrows and eyes to bring out the character's charm.　　Yong Rong was so satisfied with this portrait that he made a long inscription at the poetry hall of the painting to express his feelings: "At the beginning of the country, the god Hua Xi Yi was a late arrival in the room.
